scope: Public market source separation foundation and structural reentry correctness before activation

completed.archive_scope_guard: IncrementalCandles refuses transport/archive environment mismatch before I/O. Regression fixtures now declare their archive scope explicitly.
completed.public_shadow: Explicit --live-public-shadow collector uses LIVE host budget, advisory lock, archive partition, catalog, heads and Redis namespaces. Reads SANDBOX priority demand only; never grants execution eligibility. No ProducerPublisher, S3 lifecycle, inbound signals, QuantResearch or order transport in shadow mode.
completed.default_preserved: Without the explicit shadow flag, existing SANDBOX producer behavior remains. Shadow startup requires explicit V2_MARKET_FEATURE_VERSION, not the legacy default.
completed.publication_freshness: After durable candle archival, recheck original observation time before either S3 or S0 shadow projection. Slow archival and future timestamps cannot publish CURRENT context; no fallback to Demo.
completed.paired_comparator: Pure exact-symbol, exact-closed-minute, exact-feature-version and indicator-contract comparison of frozen LIVE/SANDBOX S3 envelopes. Decimal metrics, original source identities, UNKNOWN/PARTIAL on missing or invalid evidence; observed zero flow differs from zero-volume fallback. Does not claim raw-candle digest verification, execution permission or PnL.
completed.read_only_comparison_entry: services.v2_market_source_compare reads at most 20 requested symbols from existing Redis observations. Individual malformed sources become UNKNOWN without exposing payloads or aborting other symbols. No network price fetch, state write, automatic collector startup or fallback.
completed.external_close_attribution: Exact BINANCE_EXTERNAL_CLOSE plus EXTERNAL_REDUCE_ONLY is recorded as RECONCILED_EXTERNAL_CLOSE after existing settlement/flatness checks; liquidation and ambiguous bindings remain distinct.
completed.structural_reentry_v2: A verified external close of unknown cause must form and confirm a new post-exit structure, even when its recorded net is positive. It cannot use a profit-exit direct-breakout exemption. Unresolved/ambiguous previous orders remain ineligible. Default reentry OFF and legacy CHASE_ONLY remain unchanged.
completed.historical_replay: Explicit trade-cycle-structure-v1 recomputation preserves prior fixed-vector canonical digests. Opportunity validation binds rule version, parameters and token; relabelling a v1 proof cannot grant v2 permissions. No fixed cooldown was added.

qa.boundary: Dedicated disposable PostgreSQL/Redis/ClickHouse QA paths; TCP/UDP venue access prohibited by test audit hook; venue writes are fakes only.

final_regression.scope: 19 targeted V2 suites: market source/shadow/producer, indicator and unicode compatibility, research provenance, entry history/control, reentry/checkpoints, trade-cycle context and simulated fullflow
